thread:
rachel: quick idea — in route inspector let's surface an 'effect preview' for filters: model delta (ms / ¢), quota risk, confidence dot

omar: +1. main constraints: 1) previews must be cheap, 2) reflect route policy (fallbacks), 3) show telemetry confidence

tiffany: UX: tiny pill after model selector: "-12ms / -0.3¢" + colored dot. hover -> modal with bigger table and 'run as-saved' toggle

eng-console: API sketch:
```http
GET /api/v1/routes/{route_id}/effect_preview?candidates=redwood-7b,redwood-13b
Response: {"base":"redwood-13b","previews":[{"model":"redwood-7b","delta_ms":-12,"delta_cost_per_token":-0.003,"confidence":"MEDIUM","quota_risk":"POSSIBLE"}],"snapshot_id":"snap_2026_08_01_01"}
```

product-ops: saved-query semantics: default to 'lock model' with opt-in dynamic. store snapshot_id and routing_policy_digest. On rollout compare snapshots and alert when delta > threshold and confidence>=MEDIUM

infra-bot: deploy: effect_preview api rolled to staging behind feature flag 'effect_preview_v1' — endpoints available

rachel: next: eng-console to finalize contract, tiffany to mock pill + modal, product-ops to define alert thresholds. thanks!
